style: Editorial travel-guide illustration in loose charcoal ink linework with soft watercolor washes on warm off-white textured paper. Restrained palette: deep teal accents (#008AA3), weathered ochre yellow, moss green, warm grey, small touches of brick red and soft blossom pink. Hand-drawn, calm and airy, generous white space, people drawn with natural proportions, modest everyday clothing, relaxed candid poses, respectful depiction of Vietnamese daily life. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature; any signs are blank colour blocks.

images.prompt:
[SUBJECT] Two international women friends in their late 20s on a relaxed birthday photo walk, walking towards the viewer arm in arm and laughing: one in a flowing cream midi dress and a wide-brim straw hat holding a small bouquet of pink peach blossom, the other in a soft sage-green blouse and light trousers. A few steps to the left, a young Vietnamese photographer in a plain olive shirt crouches with a camera, gently directing them with one raised hand.
[FACES AND SKIN] Natural adult proportions; simple, confident ink faces with warm, believable skin tones in light washes; candid joyful expressions; no doll-like eyes, no airbrushed or glossy skin, no exaggerated features.
[LIGHTING] Soft late-afternoon sunlight from the right, filtering through the tree canopy, dappled warm shadows on the pavement; gentle and airy, never dramatic.
[ENVIRONMENT] A wide, calm, tree-lined boulevard in Hanoi's French Quarter: tall old trees with pale mottled trunks and a high leafy canopy; on the right a two-storey mustard-yellow French colonial villa with white trim, tall green louvred shutters and a wrought-iron balcony; in the soft far distance a cream neoclassical theatre facade with columns, only loosely suggested in pale washes; a vintage bicycle with a woven basket leaning against a tree; wide clean pavement with a few fallen leaves. Quiet and uncrowded.
[CAMERA AND COMPOSITION] Eye-level view, natural 35mm perspective, wide horizontal frame. The three figures sit in the centre and lower half. The upper-left and upper-right corners stay calm: pale sky and soft foliage only, no figures and no strong detail. The bottom edge dissolves softly into blank paper.
[DEPTH CONTROL] Foreground figures in crisp, confident linework; the villa in lighter detail; the distant theatre in faint, loose washes (atmospheric perspective, the painted equivalent of a shallow depth of field around f/2.8).
[AVOID] No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks; no balloons, birthday cake, party hats or confetti; no crowds or traffic; no neon or oversaturated colour; no 3D render, no photorealism, no anime or cartoon style.
